statements.text: A campaign is created with a supplied startTimestamp parameter and a duration of at least 1 hour.
The supplied startTimestamp is in the past relative to block.timestamp, including a campaign that has already fully elapsed before creation.
Campaign creation must enforce startTimestamp + duration > block.timestamp so a campaign cannot be created already fully elapsed.
Users pay full fees and token amounts for campaigns that can never distribute rewards
